seed: Objects of type `hud` under action ACTION5 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: x x4, no_change x3, born x1, gone x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: a field of the object itself, such as its tags, pixels, visibility or layer. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Player 5x5 moves 6 in field rows>=8; wall px block except a box holding the plate centre; first input of a level is a no-op.
Plate covered by player/ghost -> arm+key retract 6 toward the line (re-extracted with layer-1 occlusion).
hud A5 outcome = ghost-mode state: no colour-2 icon -> record (icon born at (1,1), huds x+4, player->respawn); icon present -> clear (gone, huds x-4); player on respawn -> no_change.
Ghost = trail 2 moves behind (trail restarts [start, respawn]); counter w=64-ceil(n/2) with hidden n (continuity-gated).
Unconfirmed: first-input no-op vs invisible cell at (20,14); respawn = first reached cell; stateless only 15/35 (parity/respawn hidden).
